reference.role: User-approved visual target for the Forest Bud acid puddle revision.

exact_prompt: Create ONE production game VFX color texture using the supplied approved screenshot as style reference, not an illustrative scene. Extract and re-author ONLY the acid liquid puddle as an orthographic perfectly TOP-DOWN cutout on genuinely transparent alpha background. Square 1024 texture. Bright viscous yellow-lime green poison liquid, juicy painterly stylized 3D game treatment matching screenshot, luminous yellow-green depths, broad smooth moving-looking currents, subtle broad creamy highlights along irregular lobed perimeter, thin olive wet rim. Puddle occupies central 82% of image; roughly round but naturally irregular splash silhouette with asymmetrical large rounded lobes and 5-7 disconnected tiny nearby droplets. Avoid busy micro details. No surrounding soil, no grass, no character, no fruit, no stones, no text, no perspective, no ground shadow, no solid background or checkerboard baked in, no frame. Keep center filled with clear liquid, not a hollow ring. Texture will be animated on ground-conforming 3D mesh with separate physical bubbles and fruit geometry, so no mist or bubbles painted over the center. Need strong handsome coherent silhouette and fluid material, not a glowing neon disc. Match acid color/material of screenshot.

intended_usage.type: Game VFX liquid-surface color and alpha texture

intended_usage.separate_geometry: Retained fruit fragment and animated 3D bubbles/droplets are supplied by runtime geometry, not baked into this texture.
intended_usage.gameplay: Visual presentation only; acid damage, hit radius and timing remain owned by Game.Sim.
